Before you start
ShutterSoundZero changes the setting that forces the camera shutter sound on Galaxy devices.
• Connect using wireless debugging once during setup. You can turn it off afterward.
• A One UI or Android update may reset the shutter sound setting. Setup is not required after every update. The app will notify you if you need to take action.
See Help in Settings for details and troubleshooting.

How does the shutter sound setting work?

The app disables the setting that forces the shutter sound. On devices that honor this setting, the camera follows the phone’s sound mode. Take a photo with the default camera to check. Even in Sound mode, the shutter may be inaudible if system volume is zero. If it still sounds in Mute mode with system volume at zero, send a report with diagnostics.
Why turn on wireless debugging?
It gives the app access to system settings for the initial connection and for camera setting changes. It does not need to stay on. The app tries to turn it off when finished.
Why can’t I see the pairing code?
Some dark Galaxy themes can make the six-digit code hard to see. Switch to the default theme or a lighter one, then reopen the pairing screen.
Do I need to set up again after a One UI or Android update?

If the camera setting was reset, turn on wireless debugging and tap Reapply shutter sound setting. If debugging is blocked, temporarily disable Auto Blocker in your phone’s security settings. When finished, turn off wireless debugging and turn Auto Blocker back on. An expired or removed pairing can prevent a connection even when debugging is on. If failures continue, tap Reconnect with a six-digit code in the error dialog. No action is needed if the setting is still working.
Will the setting survive a restart?
It normally persists. After a restart, the app checks the actual setting and notifies you only if you need to set it up again.
Do I need to reconnect after an app update?
A normal app update preserves your connection and settings. You will be prompted to start initial setup only if the permission was lost.
When should I reapply instead of starting initial setup?
If the connection remains but the camera setting was reset, just reapply it. Use Start initial setup if the connection is missing.
When will I receive a notification?

The app alerts you when setup or the connection needs attention, for example if a system update reset the setting or an app update affected the connection. It does not send these alerts when everything is working.
What should I keep in mind when taking photos?

Use the app for legitimate purposes, such as photographing a pet or baby or taking photos where quiet is appropriate. Do not use it for illegal or sexually intrusive photography, to photograph people unlawfully against their wishes, or to invade anyone’s privacy. You are responsible for the photos you take.
